NOT_A_PARTY: You are not a party to this payment
PAYMENT_NOT_DISPUTABLE: Only a completed or partially refunded payment can be disputed
ALREADY_HAS_OPEN_DISPUTE: There is already an open or under-review dispute for this payment
NOTIFICATION_OPENED_TITLE: A dispute was opened on a payment
NOTIFICATION_OPENED_MESSAGE: The other party opened a dispute on a payment you were part of. Our team will review it.
NOTIFICATION_RESOLVED_MESSAGE: The dispute you opened (or were part of) now has a resolution.
ALREADY_CLAIMED: Another staff member already claimed this dispute, or it is no longer available to claim
ALREADY_RESOLVED: The dispute was already resolved, withdrawn, or changed status
REFUND_AMOUNT_REQUIRED: The refund amount is required for this resolution
NOT_OPENER: Only whoever opened the dispute can withdraw it
CANNOT_WITHDRAW: The dispute can no longer be withdrawn (it was claimed or resolved)
